conversation.seed: My father died six weeks ago. I coordinated the entire funeral. I haven't cried yet. I don't know what that means.

conversation.content: My father died six weeks ago. I coordinated the entire funeral. I haven't cried yet. I don't know what that means.
You've been through a lot. It's okay to not know what to feel right now.
I guess I'm just trying to be strong for everyone else. They're all counting on me.
It sounds like you're carrying a heavy load. How do you think they would feel if you weren't so strong?
I don't know. I just feel like I have to be there for them. We're a big family, and everyone depends on me.
You're shouldering a lot of responsibility. Have you ever felt like you're just pretending to be okay when you're not?
